title: Number bonds to 10
summary: Know the pairs that make 10, and the take-away facts that go with them.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Question 1 taps extra slots for what goes with 6 to make 10. Question 2 taps two number tiles that make 10, with dots on the tiles. Questions 3 to 5 tap slots for what goes with 8, 7 and 5 to make 10. Question 6 is the part-whole cherry for what goes with 0 to make 10. Question 7 taps slots for what goes with 9 to make 10. Question 8 taps every pair that makes 10. Question 9 is a short take-away story with a tens frame. Question 10 is 10 take away 4 with a tens frame. Hints on the first three. Totals stay 10.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy taps extra slots or four tiles with dots. Medium mixes tap-to-fill with the sum line, or four tiles with 0. Hard is the sum line or tiles with no dots, mixing plus and take away. Same node: recall bonds to 10 and related subtraction.
